senses.when: plural בנים; can include daughters where the group is mixed

senses.note: Not restricted to one generation — "son of Nahor" is a grandson in Gen 29:5.

senses.sense: member of a class / one characterised by
senses.note: Idiomatic. בני האלהים in Gen 6:2 and Job 1:6, and בן חיל = a man of valour, not a son of valour. This construction is what Deut 32:8 turns on.

senses.when: bound to an animal noun, e.g. בן בקר
